title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Rebuild authorized (0111); architecture, audits and designs settled and approved (0113-0118). Pipelines scoped to fix and feat ONLY. Nothing implemented. Remaining: teach the user the new engine and the pipeline feature, then execute the eight-entry landing order.
spine.next_step: FIRST IN THE FRESH SESSION, before ANY implementation, per user directive. Two teaching deliverables in order: (1) walk through the NEW engine's phases per 0115 (Probe, Decompose+Cut, Prep, Execute, Integrate+Gate, Ship) - what each does, HOW, with EXAMPLES - plus the five deleted phases; (2) THEN the PIPELINE feature for fix and feat only per 0118 - what it is, how it works, what INPUT each needs - using the 0117 gate model. Define every term; headings/tables; no large paragraphs. THEN STOP.
open_risks: Second-system effect is the primary danger (0106); mitigation is 0110 fix-first plus 0118's two-work-type narrowing, NOT more reviewers.
12 leaked worktrees / 78 MB are a LIVE TRIPWIRE under step 4 restack (a checked-out branch blocks branch -f). hermetic-guard-test holds an UNCOMMITTED modified tracked file - human call needed first.
LSP-from-a-CLI-verb is UNPROBED (0116). Probe BEFORE the spec per 0112 rule 3, or repeat the 0103 mistake exactly.
No timing or token telemetry exists for the current 4,851-line engine. All 0114/0115 numbers are dispatch counts read from code, never measurements; the before-and-after replay is still owed.
record_decision DROPS the largest parameter on oversized payloads - keep decision outcomes under roughly 2500 characters.
Relaunch trigger for end-and-relaunch is still UNRESOLVED (0111), the last design gap in 0108.
A gate that cannot fail is worse than no gate (0112); 0107 caught the suite certifying code that cannot run. Coverage must be declared and failability-proven.
Write guard holds all .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} edits for a human, so step 0 cannot proceed unattended.
